---
title: "Projects"
# "listing" tells Quarto: find these files, and show each one as a card
# using its title / description / date / image from its top block.
listing:
  contents: "*.qmd"      # every .qmd in this folder (this index file is skipped automatically)
  type: grid             # cards in a grid. Other options: default (a list), table
  sort: "date desc"      # newest first
---
